name: A recliner instead of the armchair: the SKULNÄS rocker and swivel beside the MORABO sofa with chaise, around the UGGLERUM
notes:
Alternative, 2026-10-26, for Andrew's "chair with legrest": a's room with the SKULNÄS recliner rocker and swivel armchair (ikea-90613910, Hakebo dark gray, $499) in place of a's two POÄNG chairs and ottomans (its footrest rises on a lever). 15 placed, 8 extras.
recliner-1 SKULNÄS, 34 5/8 x 38 1/4 x 42 1/8" (floor): beside the sofa's play-side end, rot 180, x 138-172.625, y 95-133.25, facing the window; 10" off the open side's walkway edge so its backrest can recline and it can rock without entering the walkway (F-42; IKEA's page gives no reclined depth, so measure it on the floor before pushing it back), 5 7/8" off the sofa's arm, 16" short of the LÄTT (a dead gap; the way to the play wall runs east of the LÄTT, F-30). Its 360° swivel needs a 26" radius from its center (155.3, 114.1): clear of the table, which ends at x 131.875 and y 90.75, and of the LÄTT. 89" from the heater's drawn face (F-33). Not stocked at IKEA Long Island, NY: an online order for delivery; no reviews yet.
Everything else as in a: the sofa with chaise, the UGGLERUM (corner guards, F-21), the TIOKRONA turned under the sofa group, the plant at the chaise's foot, the play area, the lamps and the extras. The recliner is not in the MORABO fabric: dark gray on dark gray, two textures. With no ottoman the floor in front of the chair is open, 89" to the heater's drawn face.
Flags across the layout: delivery-path-unmeasured (the sofa, F-22), assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed.
Total $3,055.76: placed $2,807.86 + extras $247.90; prices as of 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-26 (those before today price-stale, F-02).
